location.area_description: Western unincorporated Box Elder County; MIDA Stratos Project Area private land legal description spans approximately 40,000 acres, with the initial Compute Complex identified as Wonder Valley in Salt Wells / Hansel Valley.

status_as_of_cutoff: local process: MIDA project-area plan and Box Elder County consent/interlocal actions are approved, but the county FAQ says the resolution does not approve a data center and developers still need master plan/site plan review plus state air and water-quality permits; no construction or energization verified as of 2026-08-11.

status_history.status: Approved development agreement reported in Utah government material; proposed, not construction-verified. Referendum petitions and permit gaps remain.

evidence_grade: A- official MIDA/Box Elder County documents establish project-area approval, developer, location, and planned energy scale; permit/construction status remains unverified and later scale-back reports are not reflected in official amended project-area documents found in this refresh.

actions.action_type: project-area plan adoption / development framework approvals
actions.result_status: MIDA agenda and resolution records show Resolution 2026-06 adopting the Stratos Project Area Plan, Resolution 2026-07 adopting development standards, Resolution 2026-08 authorizing a development agreement with the master developer, Ordinance 2026-01 levying a municipal energy sales and use tax, and Resolution 2026-09 approving the interlocal agreement with Box Elder County. The project-area plan becomes effective when Box Elder County grants consent.
actions.access_caveat: Utah Public Notice agenda and MIDA resolution; full final executed development agreement could not be independently text-extracted from the MIDA link during this refresh.
actions.evidence_note: Official MIDA/Utah public-notice source; status remains land-use/project-area framework, not construction.

actions.action_type: MIDA project-area consent and interlocal agreement
actions.result_status: Box Elder County announced that the County Commission approved a resolution giving MIDA consent to create the Stratos project area, which may include a data center in western unincorporated Box Elder County. The county FAQ states this did not itself approve a data center; MIDA is responsible for land rules/zoning/building permits and developers must still submit a master plan, subdivision requirements, site plans, and state air/water quality permit applications.
actions.access_caveat: Official county press release/FAQ; roll-call tally not retrieved.
actions.evidence_note: Official county source supersedes prior secondary Utah planning-material characterization.

actions.result_status: Inventory lists Wonder Valley/Stratos Phase 1 at 6,000 MW approved and Phase 2 at 1,500 MW proposed; it states construction had not begun. Capacity is inventory context, not a permit or power-on record.
actions.access_caveat: Government compiled inventory; project scope/capacity distinctions and source limitations are stated in the report.
actions.evidence_note: Body/context retained from prior file: Grand County Planning Commission staff report / Utah public-notice system.

actions.result_status: County press release says three referendum applications challenging Resolutions 26-11 and 26-12 were received on May 8 and May 11, 2026, and the County Attorney determined neither resolution was legally referable to voters; sponsors retained appeal rights.
actions.access_caveat: County legal determination; not a final court disposition of any appeal.

actions.result_status: County adopted Ordinance 654, a 180-day temporary suspension on accepting or processing new county applications for data centers, data-center power plants, and related infrastructure. County press release states the moratorium does not affect Stratos because the project area is governed by MIDA.
actions.access_caveat: Applies where Box Elder County retains land-use authority; county says it does not affect Stratos.

capacity_basis.caveat: Official interlocal agreement estimates approximately 3 GW for first phase and approximately 9 GW at buildout; this is planned energy generation/capacity context, not installed IT load or energized capacity.

owner: O'Leary Digital Utah Development Co, LLC (Master Developer; Wonder Valley branding). Public/land-use authority: Military Installation Development Authority (MIDA).

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.details: Official MIDA/Box Elder materials available during this refresh still describe approximately 40,000 acres and up to approximately 9 GW full buildout. Media/developer statements in June-August 2026 report pledges or plans to reduce the footprint and disclose a 1 GW facility plan, but no official amended Stratos project-area plan, amended interlocal agreement, or construction permit was found.

Some sources describe Stratos as approved, but Box Elder County's FAQ clarifies the county resolution does not approve a data center and that master plan/site plan plus DEQ air and water permits remain required. This file classifies status as local process, not construction or energized.
